Planning data covers everything Hackney had published by 16 October 2026, the end of its most recent weekly list. Applications validated since then are on the council's register but not yet in any list it publishes, so they are not here. Road orders are current to today.

Planning applications from Hackney Council’s weekly consultation lists. Those lists carry no date by which a comment must be made; where one is shown here it comes from the printed statutory notice, 21 days from the date of that notice. The council’s own register shows when it intends to decide, not when you can object. Road changes from the council’s published traffic order data, retrieved 25 October 2026. Boundaries: GLA and ONS London ward boundaries. Base map: Protomaps, from © OpenStreetMap contributors. Landmark buildings and postcode positions: OS OpenMap Local and OS Code-Point Open, © Crown copyright and database right, Open Government Licence v3. Markers sit at the postcode, not the building; a few sit at the centre of their ward because the council’s list gives no postcode for them. Deadlines are checked against your device’s clock.
